skills.name: switch_jarvis_mode
skills.description: Switch JARVIS between the local development workspace (test) and the isolated compiled runtime (production). Use for activate testing mode, test mood, dev mode, or activate production mode. Does not change git branches or pull updates.

mode.description: test runs the local workspace; production runs the isolated compiled runtime.

sync.description: Legacy compatibility option; mode switching does not sync git.

skills.name: get_jarvis_mode
skills.description: Check the running JARVIS mode, actual service root directory, and service state.

skills.name: sync_jarvis_branch
skills.description: Sync the active branch with latest git commits and reload JARVIS service. Use when the user asks to 'sync branch', 'sync dev', 'pull updates', or 'reload jarvis'.
